title: Normalized tensor-Hom presentation interface
statement: Fix universes $d,t,u$, a prime $\ell$, a field $E$ finite-dimensional over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $Y$ in universe $t$, a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$ in universe $d$, and $\ell\ne p$. On the small pro-etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $B=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ and $B_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_Y$ be the coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(B)$ and $D(B_n)$ of module sheaves at coefficient universe $\max(u,t+1)$. Write $H_B,H_{B_n}$ for the recorded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $F_n:D(B)\to D(B_n)$ for derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and $Q$ for complex localization. A tensor presentation for a coefficient sheaf $C$ consists of a bifunctor $T_C:D(C)\times D(C)\to D(C)$, a natural isomorphism $Q\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_C S)\simeq T_C(QP,QS)$ on all pairs of K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex], and adjunctions $T_C(K,-)\dashv H_C(K,-)$. For every K-flat $P,S$, K-injective $I$, and $q:S\to\mathcal Hom^\bullet(P,I)$, the adjunction evaluation is represented by a chain map $\beta:\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes S)\to I$ with $\beta(x\otimes s)=(-1)^{ij}q(s)(x)$ for degrees $i,j$, using the actual sheafified pure tensor, Hom-product projection, and canonical Hom localization map. A reduction presentation from $T_B$ at level $n$ consists of a tensor presentation $T_{B_n}$ and a natural isomorphism $\mu_n:F_n T_B\simeq T_{B_n}(F_n\times F_n)$. Ordinary scalar extension preserves each K-flat pair. There is an invertible chain comparison $\operatorname{Tot}(F_nP\otimes F_nS)\to F_n\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes S)$ sending the tensor of the two scalar-unit images to the scalar-unit image of $x\otimes s$; its derived square with $\mu_n$, the representative comparisons and the canonical derived reduction counits commutes. The map $c_{n,K,L}$ is defined to be the transpose of $\mu_n^{-1}$ followed by reduced evaluation. All notation and all 25 existing helper declarations are extracted from the original item, retaining their universes, names and signatures. The homModelMap body uses the existing named coefficientHomResolutionIso; a compiled rfl proof verifies definitional equality with the original inline factorization. The other 24 bodies are unchanged.
